gaps.description: Static routing was audited, but the syscall has no reviewed behavior contract with passing host and guest evidence across its Linux ABI semantics.
TheKernel dispatcher reaches its unsupported fallback; this is not evidence that Linux defines the syscall as sys_ni_syscall.
The syscall is guarded by a feature-dependent dispatch path whose enabled behavior has not yet been contract-tested.
